valmiki.prompt: Maharishi Valmiki, an elderly Indian sage with a long flowing white beard and long white hair tied in a topknot, lean bare chest with a saffron cloth draped over one shoulder, saffron dhoti, a string of rudraksha beads

narada.prompt: the sage Narada, an adult youthful sage with a clean-shaven youthful face, black hair in a topknot, white dhoti and white shawl, carrying a long-necked veena
narada.notes: Ep02: add 'clean-shaven youthful face' and 'adult' — model otherwise drifts to bearded or child Narada

bharadvaja.prompt: a young disciple with a shaven head and a small tuft of hair, white dhoti, carrying folded bark-cloth garments

rama_teaser.prompt: a young prince Rama seen from behind, standing tall holding a great bow, wearing a simple crown and dhoti
rama_teaser.notes: Shown from behind; avoid stylised blue skin unless deliberately chosen

dasharatha.prompt: King Dasharatha, a dignified middle-aged Indian king with a short grey beard and moustache, ornate golden crown, gold jewellery, rich saffron and white royal garments
dasharatha.notes: Reuse verbatim; Ep02 scene 12 showed an aged king on a throne

kausalya.prompt: Queen Kausalya, a graceful Indian queen in a white and gold silk sari with a gold crown and long braided hair

sumitra.prompt: Queen Sumitra, a gentle Indian queen in a green and gold silk sari with a small gold crown

kaikeyi.prompt: Queen Kaikeyi, a striking Indian queen in a deep red and gold silk sari with an ornate gold crown

rishyashringa.prompt: the young sage Rishyashringa, slender with matted hair in a topknot, bare chest with a white sacred thread, ochre dhoti, holding a ladle over a sacred fire

vishvamitra.prompt: the sage Vishvamitra, a tall fierce ascetic with intense eyes, long dark-and-grey matted hair and beard, a deerskin over one shoulder, rudraksha beads, holding a wooden staff
vishvamitra.notes: Distinct from Valmiki (white beard, saffron). Ep04 lead.

vasishtha.prompt: the royal guru Vasishtha, a calm elderly sage with a long silver beard, white robes and a white shawl, gentle wise expression

rama_teen.prompt: a teenage prince Rama about fifteen, seen from behind, long dark hair tied back, simple dhoti and sash, a bow on his shoulder

lakshmana_teen.prompt: a teenage prince Lakshmana about fourteen, fair complexion, alert eyes, simple dhoti, carrying a bow and quiver

tataka.prompt: a huge solid black shadow silhouette of a rakshasi with wild flowing hair and glinting fangs, only two arms, no facial detail, not a goddess, no crown, no extra arms, no wings, no horns, not a dragon, not a gargoyle
tataka.notes: Shadow silhouette only. Ep05 scene 1 first take: a 'temple mural with ornaments' prompt produced a frontal four-armed crowned goddess (reads as Kali/Durga); Ep04 scene 4 drifted to Western bat-winged gargoyles. Keep the explicit negatives.

agastya.prompt: the sage Agastya, a short sturdy elderly sage with a white beard and a topknot, saffron cloth over one shoulder, holding a kamandalu water pot

rules: Brahma and deities: symbolic depiction (radiant lotus/light) unless owner approves figurative depiction
Composition: subject centred, title headroom top 12%, captions lower 25% clear
Ravana: symbolic only (Lanka fortress / looming crowned shadow). Never a multi-armed or third-eyed dark figure, which reads as a Hindu deity form (Bhairava/Kali). Ep03 lesson.
Architecture: ancient Indian (carved stone gateways, stepped shikhara towers, pillared halls). No onion domes or minarets (Mughal-era). Ep03 lesson.
